title: Enterprise Connectivity: payout threshold and precision
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this payout threshold and precision rule to assisted overpayment payout.

## Basis: outcome
For assisted overpayment payout, an available amount below minimum cash refund produces no payout; otherwise round only the final available amount half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. Copy the original ACH rail and original payment source-event reference; the request and original payment uniquely fix the destination.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted overpayment payout basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted overpayment payout: An available amount below minimum cash refund produces no payout | otherwise round only the final available amount half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. Copy the original ACH rail and original payment source-event reference; the request and original payment uniquely fix the destination. |

## Hypothetical calculation
With a hypothetical minimum payout of USD 2 and monetary precision of two decimal places, an eligible amount of USD 1.999 produces no payout, even though rounding it would give USD 2. An eligible amount of exactly USD 2 meets the minimum and rounds to USD 2.
